# xai-cookbook

> A collection of pragmatic, real-world examples guiding you from basic to advanced use of xAI's Grok APIs.

## Overview

xai-cookbook is an open-source project by nirholas. A collection of pragmatic, real-world examples guiding you from basic to advanced use of xAI's Grok APIs.

## Repository

- URL: https://github.com/nirholas/xai-cookbook
- Language: TypeScript
- License: MIT
- Author: nirholas
